AI BALANCE PASS (user: 'better way to let the AI play + understand minor powers; is RL an option?'). Replaced the per-card Momentum eval HACK with a principled KEYWORD-AWARE evaluation: evaluate.ts unitValue() scores every keyword's strategic worth (momentum/vengeance/guard/pierce/drain/shield/haste) so the AI plays AND removes keyworded threats generically. PROOF it works: Overgrowth (Momentum go-tall) re-balanced 79%->~70% purely by tuning the Momentum threat-weight (opponents now prioritise killing growers) — NO card nerf. Tried a 2-turn greedy rollout for deeper play; it REGRESSED the ladder (skill 0.92 lost to 0.6) — a biased greedy rollout policy makes deeper search worse; capped lookahead at 1 turn (ladder monotone again: 72.5/87.5/62.5%, wide 85% > narrow 62.5%). RL VERDICT: feasible (pure deterministic engine = perfect simulator, bounded actions, low randomness, evaluate() as value bootstrap, Lacuna RL precedent) but overkill for this gate; the genuinely-deeper path is MCTS-with-determinization (explores+averages, avoids greedy-rollout bias) backing the top band, then a learned net — engine kept RL-ready. Documented in build-report.md §6 'AI approach'. SIM PASSES: spread ~37.5pts (Overgrowth 69.8% top, Deep Control 32.3% bottom), ladder monotone. VERIFIED: tsc, 45 engine tests, npm run sim, build, Playwright 4/4. Note: control decks (Deep Control ~32%) are the weakest — the greedy AI under-pilots planning-heavy control (AI-blind); flagged for /test. Stage stays build / awaiting-approval.

MCTS (user: 'explore MCTS with determinization further'). Implemented ai/mcts.ts — determinized UCT / Perfect-Information Monte Carlo: (1) DETERMINIZATION per search samples a plausible world (shuffle own deck = unknown draw order; reshuffle opponent hand+deck and re-split = unknown hand), averaging over several worlds — which also makes the AI HONEST (the old 1-ply lookahead peeked at the opponent's real hand); (2) UCT with EVAL LEAVES (no rollout — dodges the greedy-rollout bias found earlier), UCB1 minimax across turns, leaf = tanh(evaluate/40). Integrated into the continuous dial: skill>=0.8 (City champ->Worlds) plays MCTS with iterations scaling with skill; below stays greedy+1-ply. Added MoveOpts.policy + match policyA/B + sim mctsVsGreedy() head-to-head. RESULTS (sim-verified): MCTS beats greedy 91.7% at equal skill (wildfire mirror); ladder top rung 0.92-vs-0.6 rose 62.5%->90%; matrix spread UNCHANGED (~37pts) since the sim balances at skill 0.6 (greedy). RL VERDICT updated: codebase stays RL-ready but MCTS already gives strong honest top-end play with no training infra — a learned net is now only a 'push past MCTS / speed it up' future step. build-report.md §6 updated. VERIFIED: tsc, 45 engine tests, npm run sim (3 tests incl. MCTS h2h), build, Playwright 4/4. Stage stays build / awaiting-approval.
